vocabulary.definition: a place outside where you grow plants and flowers
a tiny object from a plant that grows into a new plant
the dirt in the ground where plants grow
the clear liquid that plants and people need to live
to pick fruits or vegetables when they are ready to eat

article_paragraphs.text: Our school has a special garden. Every student helps to grow vegetables and flowers there. First, we put seeds into the soil. Seeds need good soil, warm sunshine, and clean water to grow.
Every week, students water the plants. They pull out weeds so the plants have room to grow. They also check for insects that might eat the leaves. Taking care of a garden takes time and patience.

When the vegetables are ready, the class harvests them together. Last month, we picked tomatoes, cucumbers, and green beans. We used the vegetables to make a big salad and shared it at lunch. Growing your own food is a wonderful feeling!
